entities.summary: Samuel Paul Cashat, known professionally as Sammy Kershaw, is an American country music singer. He has released 16 studio albums, with three RIAA platinum certifications and two gold certifications among them. More than 25 singles have entered the Top 40 on the Billboard Hot Country Songs charts, including his only number one hit "She Don't Know She's Beautiful" and 10 more Top 10 hits: "Cadillac Style", "Anywhere but Here", "Haunted Heart", "Queen of My Double-Wide Trailer", "I Can't Reach Her Anymore", "National Working Woman's Holiday", "Third Rate Romance", "Meant to Be", "Vidalia", and "Love of My Life".

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Sammy Kershaw's chart-topping hits and consistent album releases have had a significant impact on American country music, contributing to its enduring popularity. With over 25 singles reaching the Top 40 on the Billboard Hot Country Songs charts, he has helped shape the genre for future generations.
